summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Rohana Wijeweera, a Sri Lankan Marxist politician and revolutionary. It gives his full name, birth and death dates, and his role as founding leader of the Janatha Vimukthi Peramuna. It also notes that he led the party in two unsuccessful insurrections, in 1971 and from 1987 to 1989.
one_line: Biography of Rohana Wijeweera, Sri Lankan Marxist revolutionary and founding leader of the Janatha Vimukthi Peramuna.
key_facts: Rohana Wijeweera's full name was Patabendi Don Jinadasa Nandasiri Wijeweera.
Rohana Wijeweera was born on 14 July 1943.
Rohana Wijeweera was a Sri Lankan Marxist politician.
Rohana Wijeweera was the founding leader of the Janatha Vimukthi Peramuna.
Rohana Wijeweera led the Janatha Vimukthi Peramuna in two insurrections in Sri Lanka.
The first insurrection led by Rohana Wijeweera took place in 1971.
The second insurrection led by Rohana Wijeweera took place from 1987 to 1989.
Both insurrections led by Rohana Wijeweera were unsuccessful.
